name: Kuukyo na Boku wa Nani o Miru.
source:
You have lost sight of yourself.
You no longer know who you are.

You find yourself lost in a strange space, where you meet a group of unique inhabitants.

As you talk to them, you may remember who you are.
Make choices where there is no right answer.

Who are you?
Could it be...
